summary: Narrow services/rankings/store.py to a single concrete write-owner backend: PostgresJsonOwnerStore (rankings.rankings). Generation 1 shipped a JSON-file backend and a Postgres backend side by side (RANKING_STORE_BACKEND env switch, PostgresRankingWriteStore subclassing the JSON store), which duplicated the domain's persistence implementation; that class hierarchy and the fcntl/tempfile JSON-file path are removed. RankingWriteStore now always talks to PostgresJsonOwnerStore, using compare_and_set for atomic create-conflict detection and delete_if_matches for delete. build_rankings_store() resolves a DSN/table/bootstrap from arguments or RANKING_STORE_DSN/DATABASE_URL/RANKING_STORE_TABLE/RANKING_STORE_BOOTSTRAP and always returns the Postgres-backed store; there is no backend selection left. No import of services/control-plane/bff/read_store.py and no local dict/overlay/cache/response fallback: every read re-runs a fresh SELECT through PostgresJsonOwnerStore so a write is visible to a separate store instance immediately (write-then-fresh-read), now proven against a fake psycopg connection (the same fake-connection pattern used by services/foundation/tests/test_control_plane_postgres_owner_stores.py) instead of a tmp_path JSON file. services/control-plane/bff/main.py and read_store.py are unmodified; Source Ingestion gets no new write entrypoint and remains reconcile-only against this domain.
